records.name: Task Brasil
records.notes: Charity that helps children and teens in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Philadelphia address on the IRS list (2200 Arch St Unit 704) is its US office. The site describes no Philadelphia program, and its newest dated item is from 2017. Out of area. Shares its building address with Theta Community Conference Committee.

records.name: Tequila That Cares Foundation
records.notes: Donation-focused 501(c)(3) that gives help to people in the agave spirits community in Mexico and the US. The site lists no programs, events, or volunteer roles a member of the public can join, and no Philadelphia activity. Newest dated item: three blog posts from June 14, 2023. Hidden as private because there is no public way in. Whether it is a public charity or a private foundation is not stated.

records.name: Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention
records.summary: Researchers who study how genocide begins. They publish public tools for spotting its warning signs, such as a toolbox, alerts, reports, short online courses, and a podcast.
records.what_you_do: Read the online toolbox, take a microcourse, or listen to the podcast. A volunteer page is linked from the site, and its details are not stated.

schedule.text: Online resources are available at any time. Event dates are not listed on the site.

cost.text: Course, event, and volunteer costs are not stated on the site

first_step.how: Start with the online Genocide Prevention Toolbox or one of the microcourses on the website, or email info@lemkininstitute.com to ask about volunteer roles.
first_step.basis: The learning resources are public and online, but the site does not say how volunteers join.

records.notes: IRS legal name: The Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention Inc. The Philadelphia address (821 League St) comes from the IRS list only. The site states no address and does not say it meets in Philadelphia. Its work is global and online, so the orchestrator should decide whether it belongs in a Philadelphia directory. Closest tags: talks_lectures and adult_learning, since no genocide prevention tag exists. The Year of Prevention and volunteer pages are linked with no details. Newest dated item: a statement dated September 22, 2026.

records.name: Theta Community Conference Committee
records.notes: Runs ThetaCon, an online community event for the Theta blockchain network, with Discord and social links. No Philadelphia program, dated event, or meeting place found. The 2024 copyright footer does not count as evidence, and the one news item is undated, so the status comes from a working site with no dates. The IRS address (2200 Arch St Unit 202) is shared with the Task Brasil US office, so it may be a mailing address.

records.name: To the Moon and Back Michael D Mooney Jr Foundation
records.notes: Family memorial foundation formed after a March 2017 overdose death. It helps families with part of Recovery House entry fees, gives recovery kits, and does school outreach. The site lists no events, volunteer roles, or application process, and its contact is a form only. Hidden under the family charity rule in the brief. The orchestrator may prefer a support-services listing if visitors can ask for help. Public charity or private foundation not stated.

records.name: When You Give a Bean Water
records.notes: The listed website (giveabeanwater.org) returned HTTP 404 with and without www, and the EIN lookup page returned 404 too. Not searched: the search budget went to two other groups. IRS address is 1500 Chestnut Street, 19102. Held back on purpose: no summary, so it does not show on the site. Needs a search or a manual check.

records.name: Wings for Success
records.notes: Merged into The Wardrobe. Its merger page says Wings for Success is now part of The Wardrobe, and gives no merger date. The IRS address (444 N 3rd St Ste 105) is The Wardrobe's headquarters address, so the continuing group is The Wardrobe (see leads_only). The website on the list was the merger page, not Wings' own site.

records.name: Women's Nonprofit Leadership Initiative
records.summary: Researches who sits on the boards of Greater Philadelphia's largest colleges and hospitals, and pushes for more women and people of color in those seats. Anyone can use its ready-made letters to board leaders and its tips for joining a board.
records.what_you_do: Send one of the model letters to a university or hospital board chair, read the tips for joining a higher education or healthcare board, or sign up for the mailing list to follow the research.

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list on wnli.org, or use one of the model letters on the Get Involved page to write to a board chair.
first_step.basis: Anyone can sign up or use the letters, but the site does not describe member events or volunteer roles.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a 2024 open letter with no month, so the status could be probably_active or dormant. Recheck the News and Published Content section. Research pages carry no dates, and the 2026 copyright footer does not count. The address comes from the IRS listing, not the site. Closest tags: board_service (career), womens_lgbtq_rights and racial_equity (advocacy).

notes: Batch of 15 IRS-list groups. Two of two searches used. Both went to groups a newcomer could most likely join: African Immigrants Resources Center (website field was the name cut short) and International Christian Fellowship Church (website parked). Five groups were not searched because the budget ran out: Black Thornberry Inc, When You Give a Bean Water, Daughters of Destiny, Kingdom Realm Ministries, and Chelkeinu Initiative. Those five, plus African Immigrants and ICF, are held-back records with status unknown and no summary, so they will not show on the site until someone checks them. Two groups are fully researched and publishable: Lemkin Institute (judgment call: its work is global and online, and its Philadelphia address comes only from the IRS list, so please confirm it belongs in a Philadelphia directory) and Women's Nonprofit Leadership Initiative (status probably_active, but its newest dated item is a 2024 year with no month). Fetches used: 25 of 60. No rate limiting: the failures were 404s, a 500, and parked or redirected domains. Three are out of area (Task Brasil, Theta, Keren Ezra). Two are hidden as private (Tequila That Cares Foundation, and To the Moon and Back Michael D Mooney Jr Foundation) and one as defunct (Wings for Success, merged into The Wardrobe, a Philadelphia-headquartered group now in leads_only).
